name: SWARM_ACK
description: Generic receipt acknowledgement of another message, referenced by that message's dedup UID (sender_id, boot_id, msg_seq). Redefines the reserved 25110 slot (formerly TASK_CONFIRM_ACK) with a generic, message-agnostic ack. Includes dedup/TTL metadata. The swarm task-assignment handshake acks steps 3 and 4 with it (docs/design/swarm-task-assignment-ack.md).

fields.name: boot_id
fields.desc: Random ID generated on process start, identifies sender instance.

fields.name: time_ms
fields.desc: Sender timestamp in milliseconds since epoch.

fields.name: target_system
fields.desc: Target system ID this ack is addressed to.

fields.name: ref_boot_id
fields.desc: boot_id of the message being acknowledged (dedup UID component).

fields.name: ref_msg_seq
fields.desc: msg_seq of the message being acknowledged (dedup UID component).

fields.name: ref_msg_type
fields.desc: MsgType value of the message being acknowledged.
